# UX and Display Requirements Checklist: Worktime Panel (Jira Custom Tempo)

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements for what the user sees and does (table, periods, progress bar, refresh, settings, theme, entry points) are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before tasks are generated
**Created**: 2026-11-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md) and [contracts/ui.md](../contracts/ui.md) as supporting context)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Scope chosen (defaults, no extra input was given)**: depth Standard; audience: the spec author, before `/speckit-tasks`; focus: display and interaction requirements, and period and time rules.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the colour of the totals specified for a single day with 0h logged, where no position on the progress scale exists yet? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the display format of the "Od" and "Do" fields specified (dd-mm-yyyy and 24-hour time), or left to the browser's own date-time control? [Gap, Spec §FR-023, §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the keyboard shortcut that opens the pop-up named, and is the condition under which it becomes available documented? [Gap, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for what the auto-refresh timer does after a manual refresh or a period change (restart or keep running)? [Gap, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is it specified whether auto-refresh continues while the browser tab is hidden? [Gap, Plan §Spec deltas D5]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is it specified what is shown between selecting a new period and the arrival of its data (previous period's rows, or a loading state)? [Gap, Spec §FR-034, §FR-037]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for a load that succeeds for some tickets and fails for others (show partial data, or fail as a whole)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the preset indication specified after the user moves to another period with the previous / next arrows? [Gap, Spec §FR-024, §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are keyboard and focus requirements stated for the settings pop-over and the pop-up panel (focus on open, Escape, focus return)? [Gap, Spec §FR-031, §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is it specified whether a theme saved in one open view (page, pop-up, gadget) must take effect in the other views that are already open? [Gap, Spec §FR-043, §FR-047]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are the exact Polish texts for the loading, empty, error, and validation messages part of the requirements, or only of the design contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037, Contract ui.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK012 - Is "clearly marked" for the 8-hour norm quantified with observable properties? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are "red", "yellow", "green", "blue", "violet", and "light-gray" tied to defined colour values, and are the hours at which yellow and blue are reached stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is "the user's local time zone" defined unambiguously as either the Jira profile time zone or the device time zone? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-026]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "the previous or next period of the same length" defined for calendar months and for custom ranges with clock times? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is the format of the date shown with each time entry in multi-day periods specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the end time of an entry that ends on the following day given a defined display form? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is "behave identically as a page and as a pop-up" bounded with its listed exceptions (close button, size on small screens)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is "follow the supplied inspiration images in layout and style" expressed as verifiable properties, including for the dark theme that the images do not show? [Measurability, Spec §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the scope of "all visible text MUST be in Polish" clear for content the plugin does not author (ticket titles, the browser's date-time control, Jira's own frame)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the row order defined when two tickets' earliest entries start at the same minute? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK022 - Is the accepted auto-refresh range (0 to 1440) stated as a requirement and consistent between the Functional Requirements, the Edge Cases, and the Assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is "works with no further setup" consistent with the gadget needing to be added to a dashboard by the user and with a possible one-time access prompt? [Consistency, Spec §FR-042, §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK024 - Does "appears immediately after pressing refresh" agree with the documented delay with which Jira search reflects new entries? [Conflict, Spec §SC-005, Contract jira-rest.md]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is "fully usable on phone" consistent with the Jira native mobile apps not showing the panel, and is that limit stated in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-038, Plan §Risks]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are the rules for a partial single day consistent across title (§FR-012), single-day definition (§FR-051), and the 8-hour norm (§FR-015, §FR-020)? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is "tell the status from colour and bar alone" consistent with the requirement that status is also available without relying on colour? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004, §FR-020]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK028 - Are the conditions for the 3-second targets stated (number of tickets, connection quality)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is "remains scrollable and responsive" for a 200-entry month quantified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is "clearly readable" in both appearances tied to a measurable contrast criterion in the spec itself? [Measurability, Spec §FR-048]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for Jira refusing requests because of rate limits (message shown, retry behaviour visible to the user)? [Coverage, Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the known limit on how many past time entries Jira search covers per ticket recorded as an assumption or accepted limitation in the spec? [Assumption, Gap, Contract jira-rest.md]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are layout requirements for the four table columns on narrow screens stated beyond "no horizontal scrolling"? [Coverage, Spec §FR-038, §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the assumption of short, near-constant ticket numbers addressed for projects with longer keys? [Assumption, Spec §FR-036, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is it specified which period the page shows after a browser reload (always "Dziś", or the last selected period)? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the large-period behaviour (table scrolls inside itself; header reachable) stated the same way in the spec's Edge Cases and in the plan's delta D4? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Spec deltas D4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Several items point at details that already exist in `contracts/ui.md` or `data-model.md` but not in `spec.md`; for those, the review decision is whether the detail belongs in the spec or the design files are enough

Items written for the Jira Cloud app no longer apply as worded and need re-reading against the new User Story 5: CHK003, CHK010, CHK018, CHK023, CHK025 (gadget, pop-up, command palette, Apps menu, native mobile apps). CHK036 is settled: the spec and the plan now agree on the large-period layout.
